name: web-cookie-consent-card-with-cookie-illustration-and-violet-accept-button
title: Cookie notice card with a cookie illustration on the corner, heading, paragraph, underlined More Option link and a violet Accept button
whatItIs: A white rounded bordered card with two illustrated chocolate-chip cookies overlapping its top edge, a bold heading 'Your privacy is important to us', a grey paragraph with an underlined Privacy Policy link, an underlined More Option link at the left and a violet Accept button at the right.
whatItMeans: Friendly and clear; a cookie illustration softens a legal notice.
techniques: Overlap an illustration on the card edge.
Style the secondary action as an underlined link.

vocabulary.definition: A notice asking permission for cookies.
An image overlapping a card's border.
A low-emphasis action styled as a link.
The main colour button to agree.
